title: Ivory Palm | Seagrove Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Ivory Palm — Private Pool, Gulf Views & Walk to BeachFavorite Features:- Private Pool- Near Beach
description_expanded: Ivory Palm — Private Pool, Gulf Views & Walk to Beach Favorite Features: - Private Pool - Near Beach - Gulf Views from Upper Floors About Ivory Palm: Welcome to your dream beach escape in Seagrove on 30A—where coastal charm meets luxury comfort. This stunning home offers the perfect blend of relaxation, convenience, and unforgettable Gulf views, making it an ideal choice for families and groups seeking the ultimate Florida getaway. Perfectly located along scenic Highway 30A, this beautifully designed home is just a short 5-minute walk to the sugar-white sand and emerald water. Start your mornings with coffee on the balcony as you take in breathtaking Gulf views, and end your evenings with spectacular sunsets right from your private retreat. Just minutes away, you can explore the charming town centers of Seaside and WaterColor, where you’ll find boutique shopping, local art galleries, live music, and some of the area’s most popular dining spots. Bike or stroll along the scenic Timpoochee Trail, which runs parallel to 30A and connects all the unique beach neighborhoods. Each of the four bedrooms is thoughtfully appointed to provide restful accommodations, including a luxurious primary suite with a private bathroom and balcony. With 3.5 bathrooms, there’s plenty of space for everyone to get ready for beach days or evenings out along 30A. Step outside into your private backyard oasis featuring a sparkling pool—perfect for cooling off after a day at the beach or lounging under the Florida sun. Whether you're grilling or simply relaxing poolside, this outdoor space is designed for making memories. Whether you're planning a family vacation, a couples’ retreat, or a friends’ getaway, this Seagrove Beach home offers everything you need—private pool, Gulf views, and unbeatable beach access—all in one exceptional location. Book your stay today and experience the best of 30A living!
